I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler that would send it isn't accepting my requests: every call to it fails with "gateway cron requires credentials," and I have no way to fix the gateway's auth from here. So nothing is scheduled for 09:00 tomorrow, and I haven't created a job.

I can see #coastal-team (you're a member), so the digest content is available. Once the scheduler is working, I can set it up for 09:00 America/Chicago starting 2026-10-15. Someone with gateway admin access would need to restore its credentials first. Until then, I can post a digest by hand whenever you ask.

One thing I'd build in: the digest would leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values) and point you to the channel for those, since finance figures should stay with Anselm, June and the account owner. Tell me if you want it to include them.
